findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Sensitive data, including the referenced customer workbook, is therefore not protected by an explicitly configured encryption-at-rest control.
The financials bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving stored financial data without an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest control.
The operations bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. Objects can be stored without encryption enforced by this Terraform-managed bucket configuration.
The data-science bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so this configuration does not enforce encryption for stored data.
